notes.title: Ahoy... Season 52 is on the Horizon!
notes.content:
Welcome to the latest season for Marbles on Stream!

Season 52 is here with exciting new features and enhancements:

[list]
[*] New Customizations: Explore fresh options in the shop and tournament chest.
[*] Revamped Builder Pieces: Enjoy new scale, physics, and capping logic.
[*] Updated Tilted Local Leaderboard: Smoother and more competitive.
[*] Offline Feature for Tilted: Play seamlessly even with connectivity issues.
[*] New Laps Map: Race through multiple laps for added strategy.
[*] Plus, the top streamer on the racing and royale leaderboard will receive a custom streamer skin, passed down if they already have one.
[/list]

Where will you sit at the end of the Season?

The partnership with CaptainTV and Revenue share system continues on. Visit [url=https://captain.tv/marbles]https://captain.tv/marbles[/url] to get more info!

As always keep an eye out for events taking place during the Season, so be sure to pay attention to Discord and Twitter!

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then!

We hope to have the mobile app updates for Android (GooglePlay) and the Apple iOS available shortly.

Season 52 will be ending on Friday June 21st, 2024 at 12pm ET

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/3d972911076890164e20985a8bcfa0ea685e6a86.png[/img]
---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.


[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Battle Royale, and Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season the Top 3 will have ONE of their emotes added to the game to spawn in marbles for those who use the emote.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

Play in Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Battle Royale, and Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks.

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 24 (4.24.0)
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Season 24[/b]

[b]General:[/b]
- New Season 24 Skins, Modifiers, Effects, Pins And Cards
- New Season 24 Challenges
- Updated Track: Coils of Power
- Updated Reflections in Laps Maps
- Added filtering of # when saving a map
- Added support for V2 twitch emotes
- Updated UI when the game is not fully connected to a platform
- Season Rank should say 'Not Ranked' in Player Profile widget instead of -1

[b]Bugs:[/b]
- Fixed a visual price issue when inspecting the Season Bundle
- Fixed by with jiggly Morbie Skins
- Fixed an issue with not being able to toggle slow motion during countdown
- Fixed an display issue in the local leaderboard list
- Fixed an issue with targetting a marble after showing/hiding the game HUD
- Fixed an issue where new accounts were not being read correctly when 'Requires Marble Account' is selected to join the race
- Pixel's Procedural Pathway should no longer turn red in the map list

[b]Track Builder:[/b]
- Builder Ghost Speed Fixed
- New Right Angle Triangle Simple Shape
- New Coil of Power Obstacle
- New Skybox
- New Track Texture
- Updated upload map UI

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 22 (4.22.0)
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Season 22 (Year 4)[/b]

[b]General:[/b]
- New Season 22 Skin, Modifiers, Effects, Pins And Cards
- New Shop Sections: Skins/Modifiers, Effects/Trails, Pins/Cards
- New Customization Section: Viewer
    -- Customize your own marble loadout (just like the Marbles On Stream Mobile App)
- New Season 22 Challenges
- The Paperclip race map revamped with new assets
- Updated custom map name when viewing the local list in the race menu
- Fixed an issue where custom names used in simulation races where being populated from bottom to top
- Update !play image in event feed
- S19 Winners Emotes removed
- S21 Winners Emotes Added

[b]Tilted:[/b]
- Added tracking of top points earner in viewer races (Top Tiltee)
- Added an option for seeding the randomization of the track (Hidden/Available during approved events)
- Updated Track Collisions
- Updated Tilt Board Speeds (Tilt/Return)
- Updated Camera Scroll Speeds
- Kill Feed Now Active

[b]Track Builder:[/b]
- Max Track Pieces Season Pass changed from 325 to 340
- Max Obstacles Season Pass changed from: 125 to 135
- Fixed bug where player could get stuck in the settings while track building
- New Skybox (Season Pass)
- New Glass Material (Season Pass)
- New Start Piece (Season Pass)
- Fixed Crash in Builder when testing a track and moving back to test again

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 21 (3.21.0)

[b]General:[/b][list][*]New Maps: The Boomerang
[*]Laps2 renamed to The Paperclip

or with the selected views

[*]Max season pass obstacles changed from 105 to 125
[*]New pieces: Lazer, Reverse Splits
[*]New Material: Forest Floor
[*]New Skybox: Spooky Trees
[*]Fixed bug with Portals rotating
[*]Fixed bug with marble movement direction after teleporting
[*]Fixed bug with Chad rotating out of place[/list]

[*]Fixed a bug where draw bridge back half separated
[*]Fixed a bug with steve lifting off of the floor
[*]XP change for amount of racers finished per level[/list]

[b]Royale:[/b][list][*]Streamer XP changed per race[/list]

[b]General:[/b][list][*]This season all streamers can play to win a PC giveaway courtesy of NewEgg! See the home screen in game for details!
[*]This season all racers can enter to win a PC giveaway courtesy of NewEgg! See the home screen in game for details!
[*]New Map: Marbles Diner

[*]New Season 18 Challenges
[*]Added new race settings for further subscriber filtering (months subbed and sub tier). This doesn't apply to Founders
[*]Added new race settings for filtering players with a marble account
[*]Weight mode should no longer override previous ghost replays[/list]

[b]Track Builder:[/b][list][*]New Pieces: Portals, Hair Curler, Simple Start
[*]New Skybox backgrounds added
[*]Added cube and booster color customization
[*]Bug fix for the Steve track piece
[*]Added Steve direction selection
[*]Added copy (alt) functionality to rotation
[*]Word list updated[/list]

[b]Tilted (Revamp):[/b][list][*]Track generation updated
[*]Difficulty now changes every 5 levels
[*]Adjusted SeasonXP earned per level
[*]All track pieces have received a visual and design update
[*]Level results now show (players finished / total players) instead of the percent
[*]Leaderboard around the player will show at the end of a level
[*]Header timer now shows the total run time, and is no longer reset per level
[*]New Steam Achievements[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixes:[/b][list][*]Fixed a bug where leaderboard spawn in effect could get stuck at their spawn point
[*]Fixed a bug where leaderboard spawn in would move to incorrect locations

[*]Fixed a bug with filtering grand prix results[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 16 - (3.0.0.0)
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Season 16 - (3.0.0.0)[/b]
[list][*]New Maps: Castle Siege
[*]New Season Skins, Modifiers, Effects, Trails, Pins, Season Bundle and PlayerCards have been added
[*]New Season Challenges have been added
[*]Players can now customize Marble Skins, Modifiers, Pins and Player Cards in the MOS Mobile App
[*]The shop is now on a global timer
[*]Items in the customization menu are now ordered alphabetically
[*]Random Skin description text in the loadout should be more legible
[*]Team racing should change marble name color instead of the pin image color
[*]Energy Tier sorting at the end of race should now sort by those closest to reaching their next tier
[*]Track UVs have been updated on certain pieces in the game[/list]
[b]Track Builder:[/b][list][*]New Marble Clock
[*]New Long Flat Pieces with boosters
[*]Funnel Updates (Now Dynamic Exits)
[*]New Marble Tubes[/list]
[b]Tilted:[/b][list][*]Updated collisions on all bumpy tiles[/list]
[b]Patch notes for mobile - Android: ([i]iOS update coming soon[/i])[/b][list][*]New: Season 16 Skins, Modifiers, Effects, Trails, Pins, and Player Cards have been added
[*]New: Skin, Marble Modifiers, Pins, and Player Cards can now be customized in player load outs
[*]New: Skin, Modifiers, Pins, Player Cards, and the Season Exclusive Bundle have been added to the shop
[*]New: All Marble Effects can be selected as spawn and/or finish
[*]New: The App has received a UI overhaul[/list]
[i]Important: This is a companion app for the stream interactive game: Marbles On Stream[/i]
[b]Bugs Fixes:[/b][list][*]Fixed an issue in Royale where the end of race chat bubble would not re-open an already read message
[*]Simulation name winner should no longer show in voting menus
[*]Random track button should no longer show up at the end of boost mode
[*]Fixed a small seem in Tundra Tumble 2[/list]

notes.title: Season 15 Mid-Season UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Season 15 Mid-Season Update!!![/b]

Today (February 28th, 2020) we will be pushing a Mid Season update for Marbles on Stream.

[u][b]Included in this update[/b][/u]:[list][*] A total re-write of [u]Pixel's Procedural Pathway[/u].
[*] A new map builder piece.
[*] Some updated streamer marbles
[*] Skip Track button added for grand-prix races
[*] Add a notification when their is no active local leaderboard when viewing local results at the end of a race
[/list]
[b]Arcade Mode[/b][list][*] In this new Arcade Mode points do not count and you will not use any energy to enter in these races! Master the new !Boost system that will ONLY work in this new mode where again [u]you will not earn any points or XP[/u]. So have some fun with this new mode, capture some amazing clips and submit them to our discord.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list][*] Fixed an issue where chat bubbles in the grand prix results UI were not showing
[*] Fixed an issue where player name color wasn't correctly showing in the grand prix results Chat History window
[*] Fixed an issue where the latest race winner was being populated by a simulation marble in the map selection UI[/list]

The big Season 16 Update is planned for Wednesday April 1st, 2020

Let us know what you think of this new Arcade and Boost Mode!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 14 - (2.0.2.0)
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Season 14 - (2.0.2.0)[/b]

- New Maps: Mountain Pass 2, Tundra Tumble 2, On Thin Ice 2, Frozen 2, Slippery Slopes 2
- New Season Skins and Modifiers have been added
- New: You can now select community maps for a Grand Prix
- New Season Challenges have been added
- Streamer Season XP Changes:[list][*]- 1 Bonus race is awarded per hour (120 cap)
[*]- Earn 2x XP for bonus races
[*]- Earn Bonus XP when viewers complete energy tiers
[/list]
- Viewer Energy Changes:[list][*]- Energy is reset to 50 at 3a.m. EST each day
[*]- Earn energy back from completing bonus tiers in unique streams
[*]- You cannot earn energy back or earn points if you have reached 0 energy for the day
[*]- Tier progress can be seen at the end of race screen in the Bonus column
[*]- Energy earned can be seen at the end of race screen to the right 
[/list]
- Shop Revamp:[list][*]- Items in the shop are rotated daily and hourly
[*]- An inspection panel has been added to give more detailed information about each item and item type
[*]- You can now get a more detailed view of skins and modifiers using the marble preview inside the inspection panel. Click and drag the previewmarble to rotate the model
[*] - Streamer Skins now have their own section and have an input field for searching
[/list]
- Merchandise button added to the main menu
- Added home button now visible in the main menu
- The podium level at the end of a grand prix has been updated
- Added animations for notifying a claimable challenge reward, shop rotations, and when items are added for customization
- Added challenge progress UI/animations that display at the end of a race if season xp was earned
- Top Streamers has been added to the home screen
- The Main Menu world has been updated
- Updated the Energy column at the end race screen
- Season leaderboard ranks are now updated as they were in previous seasons (every 5-10 minutes)

[b]Track Builder:[/b]
- Test Marbles now load with Equipped Everyone Skins
- Map Boundaries no longer interfere with testing
- UI Cleanup
- New Straight Piece Variant
- Bingo Ball Geometry Updates
- Many minor geometry updates
- Removed old end buckets
- Added 3 new end buckets without center protrusion
- Added Cannon functionaltiy to Rock Blaster
- Fixed bug with track piece count not updating on load
- New ending drop track piece
- 4 New Map Textures
- Fixed a bug where snap spheres would not update on flipped piece
- Fixed a bug where you could select destructible objects and delete them
- New starting pieces have been added
- Slow motion can now be used in test marble mode
- Physics objects now work during test marble mode
- Hover and click logic for components that light up has been updated
- Updated my maps (open) menu to be more visually friendly
- Added new names to choose from when uploading maps

[b]Bugs Fixes:[/b]
- Marble data for ghost marbles should no longer be recorded when playing custom maps (was causing the game to hang on very long tracks for some users)
- Fixed an issue where streamer bonus xp was not showing in the profile widget on login
- Fixed an issue in Tilted where toggling the settings button at the end of a run showed the incorrect screen
- Fixed an issue where the tilted leaderboard was populating twice
- Fixed an issue with tips not showing in certain areas of the main menu

[b]MOS Mobile patch notes: ([i]Update on Android only, iOS should be updated soon[/i])[/b]
- New Spawn Effects: Snowman, Snowflake Swirl, Santa Sled
- New Trail Effects: Top Hat, Santa Hat, Deer Antlers
- New Finish Effects: Snowflake Finish, Ice Finish

notes.title: Season 14 Energy and Points System Update
notes.content:
With the launch of Season 14 we are changing up the way the Racer Energy and Streamer Points systems work. Moving forward we are working to have the Marbles XP and Point system coincide along with the new changes Twitch has been making for viewers and streamers to have better alignment with our Marbles Racers and Streamers.

Below is a breakdown of how the new Season 14 system will work:

[b]Racer System[/b]
[list][*] Start each day 3am EST (12am PST) Racers will reset to  have 50 Energy.
[*] 1 Energy Spent per race participated in (Energy only spent on race completion)
[*] Earn Energy from completing bonus tiers in unique streams (meaning 5, 10, 20, etc in one individuals stream.)
    -Tier 1 = 5 total Races -> 5 Energy returned
    -Tier 2 = 10 total Races -> 6 Energy returned
    -Tier 3 = 20 total Races -> 12 Energy returned
    -Tier 4 = 40 total Races -> 20 Energy returned
    -Tier 5 = 60 total Races -> 20 Energy returned
    -Tier 6 = 100 total Races -> 40 Energy returned
[/list][i]0 Energy = 0 Season points distributed (Does effect Grand Prix, Does NOT effect local leaderboards)[/i][img]https://i.ibb.co/7V2kTf3/Point-system.png[/img]

[b]Streamer System[/b]
[list][*] 1 Bonus bonus races awarded per hour caps at 120
[*] Earn 2x XP for Bonus Races (1 Bonus race spent per race)
[*] Max Bonus XP for time in race 3 Mins (reduced from 6 Min)
[*] Earn Bonus XP for completing viewer tiers. Tier = XP rewarded
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co/LnPtJjP/Point-system2.png[/img]
If you have any questions about this new system please post it below.

[b][i]If there are any updates to this system from now until actual launch this entry will be updated![/i][/b]

[b]NOTE:[/b] This implementation will only effect racers and streamers who play marbles at a global competitive level.

Season 14 is going to be unlike any other, it also marks the final update of 2019 and this decade!!!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 13 - (2.0.1.7 and 2.0.1.8)
notes.content:
New Maps: Cosmic Chaos 2, The Space Station, Marble Centauri 2
New Skins: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Sun, Solar Panel
New Meshes: Sphere, Alien, Sci-Fi
New Season 13 challenges
Added new player card tags: Season Marbler, Founder, Track Record
The game has been updated to unreal engine 4.23
You are now able to favorite community maps at the end of a custom map race
Added support for twitch founders
Rank on the player card changed to Todays Rank
The Viewer Season Leaderboard is now compiled daily
Viewer season information on the player card and end of races is closer to realtime
Fullscreen Video settings have been removed until further notice due to a crash with 4.23
At this time it is recommended to turn GSync off as it appears to cause the game to hang at the loading screen
New pbp coins meshes have been updated

Tilted:
- Max number of players changed to 100
- Minimum number of marbles required to complete a level has been changed to 3
- Updated turn pieces to have more accurate positions for the player follow camera
- New steam achievements added

Track Builder:
- New track pieces
- New materials
- 3 New skyboxes 
- Snap sphere colors have been changed to reflect snap locations
- Fixed a performance issue with multiselecting
- Cube custom time added
- Pin customization expanded
- New Start Piece Vertical 
- New Track Type (Low Profile)
- New Loops Implemented
- Moguls now have 4 Versions to use
- Caps Added for Many Simple Pieces
- 3 New Funnel Models
- 3 new Track Materials (Alienated, PowerGrid, Red Brick)
- New Glass for Regular Track
- Removed Pieces: 2 Old Loops, Danglies
- Removed thin Wide Dynamic pieces (Thick version remains)
- Cross Jump Boosts Removed for more Customization
- Snap Sphere Functionality Revamp
- Snap Spheres are now Colored to Represent (Entry, Exit and Obstacle)
- Selection Logic Revamp
- Changed Gizmo Origin Logic
- Changed how selection is handled to assist in more precise movement for the entire selection
- Drop Marble is now a Mode and Lock the UI so testing can be conducted Cleanly
- X Piece centered
- Split Pieces Adjusted models
- Reworked Huge Funnel Start Piece
- Reworked UI to be able to hide spawn and scroll panels
- Sphere Logic will now handle obstacles in multiselection

Bugs Fixes:
- Fixed an issue with being unable to purchase the season map builder pass
- Fixed an issue where the season number and date range were not populating in the main menu
- Tilted tournament flag should show up correctly upon login
- Fixed an issue with a false error showing when only 1 favorite was in the favorite community maps list
- Fixed a search issue with the viewer leaderboard
- Fixed a crash issue when the game was starting loading in fullscreen
- Fixed bug with Dojo Piece having bad Origin
- Fixed rotation bug where rotation gizmo would no be clickable
- Fixed bug where attached obstacle list would be hidden after interacting with obstacles
- Selection Logic now handles tracks and obstacles correctly
- Fixed an issue with textures loading on loops
- Fixed an issue with incorrect or missing fonts for usernames and messages from twitch chat
- Fixed an issue where all game features were available when a twitch or steam account failed to link (i.e. tilted, viewer races, uploading maps)
- Fixed an issue where 0 was being displayed when team damage was enabled or while in the Marble Royale Game Mode
- Elimination feed for team racing should display correctly again
- Fixed an issue where upload map button was visible when it should be hidden
- Fixed incorrect information for the map builder pass (was showing lower values for tracks and obstacles)
- Fixed an issue with the pbp coin marble textures
- Twitch founders should correctly be able to choose subscriber only marbles
- Fixed an issue where the game was crashing on startup due to having preferred fullscreen settings

notes.title: Welcome Everyone to the Marbles On Stream (MOS), Steam Community Hub!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome Everyone to the Marbles On Stream (MOS), Steam Community Hub[/b]

First of all we want to thank everyone for joining us for the first couple days so far of Season 13 of Marbles on Stream. New and returning users to Marbles, thank you for choosing to and continuing to share the experience of Marbles on Stream with your communities, we would not be here without you all. 

So we continue forward. As you may have noticed, we have already started posting events that are happening throughout the season. The events are:
[list]
[*] Community Day Every Single Friday [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixelbypixelstudios]Twitch.tv/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url][/b]. Race with the Marbles you want to win.
[*] Tournament Kits hosted by Streamers (Tues/Thurs/Fri/Sat) these are free to participate in and are high profile events for coins and exclusive effects
[*] Mid Season Tournament Hosted by Community Managers and Marbler of the Season Free Participation and Prizes available
[*] End of Season Tournament Hosted by Pixel by Pixel Studios and 2 hand Picked Streamers
[/list]

If you do not know what MoS is, it is a stream interactive game designed for streamers to involve their viewers in marble races. Our goals are always to produce high quality content for you all to enjoy with your communities. We also have a Community map builder where you can build and upload maps, or even Tilted Mode which gives the user control of the marbles that have joined to get as far as you can through procedurally generated tracks.

About the Studio:
We are a small dev team, new to the industry, excited to develop for a very active online community. 

One of our goals is to be easily accessible to everyone. If you want to interact with myself (Mike), the rest of the dev team or Marbles On Stream community, post your questions, concerns, or feedback here:
[list]
[*] Steam Community: Hub [url=steamcommunity.com/app/1170970]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1170970[/url]
[*] Discord: [url=Discord.gg/PixelbyPixelStudios]Discord.gg/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url]
[*] Twitch Streams: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixelbypixelstudios]Twitch.tv/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url]
[/list]
Reach out, we are always happy to chat, whether it be to discuss the game, your streams, or even how we can better create content for you to share with your communities, we are always open to constructive conversations.

Thanks again from everyone here at 
Pixel by Pixel Studios.
